notes.title: CAR DETAILING SIMULATOR: PROLOGUE | UPDATE AND FIXES
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Hello Detailers! 🚗[/h2][/b]

We have prepared a big update for the Car Detailing Simulator. We tried to meet most of your ideas, suggestions and expectations, which you keep sending us. Thanks to you we know what else needs to be done to make the full version of the game meet all your expectations. Thank you for your commitment.

[b]In the update you can download now, the most important changes are:[/b]
[list]
[*] opening movie,
[*] inversion of the Y axis,
[*] fov setting,
[*] color for color blinders,
[*] fixes for stability and performance
[/list]
[h3]🎅[b] And the most important! We already have a holiday season, so we've added some holiday accessories to the garage stage, and to the menu![/b] 🎄 [/h3]

Make sure to let me know what you think and one more time, thank you for all your feedback and Steam review. 💪

notes.title: Car Detailing Simulator: Prologue - RELEASE STREAM
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello Detailers! 🚗 [/b][/h2]
[b][h3]Finally![/h3][/b]
We are happy to announce that our Prologue and pre-recorded stream of [b]Car Detailing Simulator: Prologue[/b] will be available [b]today from 6 am PST! [/b] (Stream maybe a little earlier) and at this time you will be able to play the game for free.

⌚ Watch our pre-recorded stream showing gameplay of first stages of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1661270/Car_Detailing_Simulator_Prologue/
[b]Remember to leave us your opinion and Steam review after playing, each of them is important to us. 😊[/b]

We are really excited and can't wait for your feedback! All suggestions and reports are extremely important to us, and we are counting on every thought and opinion!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1661270/discussions/0/5371100420935326035/]🚘 PROLOGUE | SUGGESTIONS & FEEDBACK[/url]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1661270/discussions/0/5371100420935323940/]🚘 PROLOGUE | BUGS & PROBLEMS[/url]

[b]Difference between the demo and the prologue?[/b]

The most important difference is that the prologue is much longer gameplay than in the demo version, which will allow you to spend a few hours of gameplay. You will get to know many new interesting features in relation to the demo, and most of the changes can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1661270/announcements/detail/4432099896022204523]here[/url]. It's a good opportunity to learn how to play before the premiere of the full version!


Regards, 
Car Detailing Simulator Team

notes.title: CHANGES IN TERMS OF THE DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, Detailers! 🚘 [/b][/h3]

We listened to your suggestions (we really read ALL comments😎) and the biggest changes between demo and prologue, we added:
[list]
[*] graphic fixes for the first garage
[*] a second garage added
[*] new models of boxes with sets of tools
[*] degree of cleaning separately for each part
[*] highlighting of uncleaned elements
[*] camera transitions between wheels and windows
[*] a new camera system attached to the car
[*] performance improvement
[*] graphic corrections to materials
[*] new tool models
[*] new window and car body contamination display system (more accurate)
[*] new cleaning steps in tasks
[*] graphic enhancements for UI
[*] less invasive tutorial
[*] more sounds
[*] controller support
[/list]
These are just some changes compared to the demo version. The prologue will contain much more expanded gameplay and more features, and most importantly, it will allow for longer gameplay. Make sure to leave us a comment if you are also excited!
